purpose: Record whether each standard-chain role has a clear human-like responsibility boundary, a downstream-consumable output, and a low-noise handoff for this fresh run.
old_pilot_evidence_policy: Historical pilot artifacts may inform repository patterns but are not accepted as completion evidence for this run.

roles.responsibility_boundary: root problem, goals, scope, rules, and single-phase plan only
roles.noise_control: No UNIT, AC, design, QA, or delivery conclusions were written before Manager ownership.

roles.output: refined brief, phase-prd unit_index, and UNIT-1..UNIT-3 definitions
roles.responsibility_boundary: business flow, UNIT boundaries, AC, exclusions, and PM review closure
roles.noise_control: Director locked_fields and locked_field_digest stayed unchanged.

roles.input: refined PM artifacts and repository scan evidence
roles.output: design.json with option analysis, interfaces, runtime facts, verification, and rollback
roles.responsibility_boundary: technical design and interface boundary, not implementation or QA verdict
roles.noise_control: Historical code is recorded only as pattern input; v2 implementation/test paths are separate.

roles.input: brief, phase-prd, UNIT definitions, and design.json
roles.responsibility_boundary: test coverage, equivalence classes, QA handoff, and design gap reporting
roles.noise_control: Each UNIT has a separate test-cases artifact instead of one mixed catch-all report.

roles.input: canonical PM, design, and test-design artifacts
roles.responsibility_boundary: scope freeze, traceable tasks, real proving commands, and plan confirmation
roles.noise_control: Tasks include file ranges and v2-only proving commands.

roles.output: v2 implementation, tests, smoke support, and developer-report.json files
roles.responsibility_boundary: TDD implementation within declared file ranges
roles.noise_control: Fresh RED/GREEN evidence is required for v2 paths; old test commands are excluded.

roles.responsibility_boundary: implementation quality, risk, and regression findings
roles.noise_control: Review consumes reports and v2 file anchors, not historical pilot summaries.

roles.input: plan, tasks, developer reports, design, and test cases
roles.responsibility_boundary: Task-level AC coverage and evidence verification
roles.noise_control: Each verify result is scoped to one task and active plan/tasks refs.

roles.input: brief, phase-prd, unit definitions, design, test cases, review, reports, and verify results
roles.responsibility_boundary: user-visible release quality and QA handoff closure
roles.noise_control: QA result maps stage evidence to v2 acceptance and does not decide signoff.

roles.input: full phase artifact set and QA/consistency results
roles.responsibility_boundary: delivery control, signoff packaging, and final evidence closure
roles.noise_control: Delivery owns final control state and does not rewrite upstream truth artifacts.

noise_checks.description: Director locked fields remain byte-for-byte aligned with director_confirmation.locked_fields.
V2 implementation and tests use examples/login_homepage_v2_app and tests/test_login_homepage_v2_app.py.
Smoke script validates login-homepage-v2 paths and blocks historical pilot evidence leakage.
